arxiv-2112-00872.title: Coherent States for infinite homogeneous waveguide arrays: Cauchy coherent states for E ⁡ ( 2 ) E(2)
arxiv-2112-00872.creator: Julio Guerrero, Francisco F. López-Ruiz
arxiv-2112-00872.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Julio Guerrero, Francisco F. López-Ruiz. Perelomov coherent states for equally spaced, infinite homogeneous waveguide arrays with Euclidean E(2) symmetry are defined, and a new resolution of the identity is obtained. The key point to construct this novel resolution of the identity is the fact that coherent states satisfy the Helmholtz equation (in coherent states labels), and thus every coherent state belongs to a one-parameter family uniquely determined by the Cauchy initial data of the coherent state in a one-dimensional Cauchy set.

arxiv-2305-08351.title: Enabling Failure Recovery for On-The-Move Mobile Manipulation
arxiv-2305-08351.creator: Ben Burgess-Limerick, Chris Lehnert, Jürgen Leitner, Peter Corke
arxiv-2305-08351.description: Abstract We present a robot base placement and control method that enables a mobile manipulator to gracefully recover from manipulation failures while performing tasks on-the-move. A mobile manipulator in motion has a limited window to complete a task, unlike when stationary where it can make repeated attempts until successful.

arxiv-2307-04645.title: Invariants of Non-Isolated Singularities of Hypersurfaces
arxiv-2307-04645.creator: Yotam Svoray
arxiv-2307-04645.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yotam Svoray. In this paper we generalize some results by Siersma, Pellikaan, and de Jong regarding morsifications of singular hypersurfaces whose singular locus is a smooth curve, and present some applications to the study of Yomdin-type isolated singularities. In order to prove these results, we discuss the transversal discriminant of such singularities and how it relates to other algebraic and topological invariants.

arxiv-2412-05395.title: Modulation of electronic and piezoelectric properties of lead-free halide perovskites LiSnX 3 (X = Cl, Br, and I) under applied pressure
arxiv-2412-05395.creator: Celestine Lalengmawia, R. Zosiamliana, Bernard Lalroliana, Lalhum Hima, Shivraj Gurung, Lalhriat Zuala, Lalmuanpuia Vanchhawng, Amel Laref, A. Yvaz, D. P. Rai
arxiv-2412-05395.description: Abstract Pb-based perovskites are considered to be the most efficient materials for energy harvest. However, real-time application is limited because of their toxicity. As a result, lead-free perovskites that offer similar advantages are potential alternatives. Here, we have chosen LiSnX 3 (X = Cl, Br, and I) for further calculation and explore its possibilities for harvesting clean and green energy.

arxiv-2502-12267.creator: Xi Zheng, Ziyang Li, Ivan Ruchkin, Ruzica Piskac, Miroslav Pajic
arxiv-2502-12267.description: Abstract . Autonomous cyber-physical systems (CPSs) leverage AI for perception, planning, and control but face trust and safety certification challenges due to inherent uncertainties. The neurosymbolic paradigm replaces stochastic layers with interpretable symbolic AI, enabling determinism. While promising, challenges like multisensor fusion, adaptability, and verification remain.

arxiv-2601-09928.title: In-Browser Agents for Search Assistance CCS: Information systems Personalization CCS: Information systems Web search engines CCS: Information systems Users and interactive retrieval CCS: Security and privacy Privacy-preserving technologies CCS: Human-centered computing User models
arxiv-2601-09928.creator: Saber Zerhoudi, Michael Granitzer
arxiv-2601-09928.description: Abstract . A fundamental tension exists between the demand for sophisticated AI assistance in web search and the need for user data privacy. Current centralized models require users to transmit sensitive browsing data to external services, which limits user control. In this paper, we present a browser extension 1 1 1 https://github.com/saberzerhoudi/agentic-search-plugin that provides a viable in-browser alternative.

pmc-11355302.title: An Analysis of Ocular Biometrics: A Comprehensive Retrospective Study in a Large Cohort of Pediatric Cataract Patients
pmc-11355302.creator: Luca Schwarzenbacher, Lorenz Wassermann, Sandra Rezar-Dreindl, Gregor S. Reiter, Ursula Schmidt-Erfurth, Eva Stifter
pmc-11355302.description: Objectives: This study aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of ocular biometric parameters in pediatric patients with cataracts to optimize surgical outcomes. By evaluating various biometric data, we seek to enhance the decision-making process for intraocular lens (IOL) placement, particularly with advanced technologies like femtosecond lasers.

pmc-11464866.title: Perceived Social Status and Oral Health Among Medicaid Insured Adults in Iowa
pmc-11464866.creator: Jennifer M.C. Sukalski, Natoshia M. Askelson, Julie C. Reynolds, Peter C. Damiano, Wei Shi, Xian Jin Xie, Susan C. McKernan
pmc-11464866.description: Purpose:Perceived social status (PSS), a measure of social status, reflects cumulative lifetime effects of an individual’s relative social status based on resources and lived experiences. PSS is hypothesized to better capture social status compared to traditional measures of socioeconomic status (SES) (i.e., education, occupation, and income).

pmc-11635871.creator: Ali Alsaqr, Manal Alharbi, Noura Aldossary, Abdulaziz Alruwished, Mohammed Alharbi, Khalid Alghaib, Abeer Alabdulkarim, Alhamdan Shatha, Ali Abusharha
pmc-11635871.description: ObjectivePeripheral refraction is associated with myopia development. pmc-13116174.title: Digital Governance at the Street Level: A Mixed-Methods Study of Systemic Resilience and ‘Human-in-the-Loop’ Telemedicine in Rural Thailand
pmc-13116174.creator: Nathachon Tarnthong, Chitralada Chaiya
pmc-13116174.description: Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? pmc-13571766.title: Quinoxaline as Dual Modulators of Apoptotic Regulators Bcl-2 and Bax: A Combined In Vitro and In Silico Anticancer Approach
pmc-13571766.creator: Cecileya Jasmin Meshak Dhanashekaran, Vinod Prabhu Venugopal, Nivetha Chokkalingam, Kunnathur Murugesan Sakthivel, Radhakrishnan Narayanaswamy
pmc-13571766.description: Objective:This study aimed to evaluate the antioxidant potential of quinoxaline and investigate its molecular interactions with cancer-related proteins through computational docking.Methods:Antioxidant activity of quinoxaline was assessed using DPPH, FRAP, ABTS, hydrogen peroxide, superoxide, and reducing power assays at varying concentrations, and IC50 values were calculated.

pmc-13642101.title: Single‐Photon Emission From TMDCs through Strong Coupling to EQ Plasmon Modes of an Au Metasurface
pmc-13642101.creator: Andergachew Mekonnen Berhe, Haroldo T Hattori, Andrey E Miroshnichenko
pmc-13642101.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In this study, we theoretically demonstrate that a strongly coupled hybrid platform consisting of a compact gold plasmonic metamaterial (metasurface) and a monolayer of transition‐metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) enables scalable single‐photon emission (SPE) at room temperature. The Au metasurface is designed to support electric‐quadrupole (EQ) resonance that efficiently couples to excitons in tungsten diselenide (WSe2), molybdenum disulfide (MoS2), and molybdenum diselenide (MoSe2).
